verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a chat and community platform, since alternatives in this category offer self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Discord can be self-hosted. The docs describe a hosted service reached via REST API, Gateway WebSockets, webhooks and SDKs. Bots and 'server-side' provisional-account flows run against Discord's own infrastructure, which makes them developer building blocks rather than self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
